gold.user: User wants to create a new transcription for a specific call using Twilio's API. They provide the Account SID and Call SID to identify the call, and they may also include parameters such as the transcription's language and whether to record the transcription in real-time.
gold.ideal: The API should return a success response with the details of the created transcription, including its SID, status, and any other relevant metadata.

gold.user: User needs to update an existing transcription for a specific call. They provide the Account SID, Call SID, and the transcription SID to identify which transcription to update. They may want to change the transcription text or its status.
gold.ideal: The API should return a success response confirming the update, along with the updated details of the transcription.
